title: The Coffee Lid Isn’t tight.
text: The Coffee Lid Isn’t tight.. Love them and they look great but like other reviewers here the lid on the coffee canister doesn’t seal tightly. Afraid I might move it some way and the lid will come off and spill. Extra careful with it.

product_metadata.title: DII Kitchen Accessories Retro Collection, Ceramics, Canister Set, Blue, 3 Piece
features: SIMPLE, SOPHISTICATED, FUNCTIONAL: Set includes 3 canisters; Coffee Canister measures 4.5 x 4.5 x 5.5" and holds 4.5 cups; Sugar Canister measures 4 x 4 x 4.5" and holds 3 cups; Tea Canister measures: 3 x 3 x 4" and holds 1.25 cups
INSTRUCTIONS: To seal lid effectively, press firmly down then rotate at least a quarter turn. Lids are not airtight

MATERIAL AND CARE: Heavy duty ceramics are dishwasher safe; For the bamboo lids, simply remove the silicone attached along the lid, hand wash with soap and rinse with water; Wrap the silicone around the lid again and seal back up to use again
